text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
choice_data_list: You've looked sleepy lately, haven't you?
You've looked sleepy lately, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
You know that video series, 'Great Odyssey of the World's Creatures'?
I've been watching it when I get home lately.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Animals all over the world, living strong out in the great outdoors... It's so wonderful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Actually, you might've made me want to go see it in person.
choice_data_list: L-Let's save that for after the races have settled down!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I know!
Traveling the world can wait for later, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*...
I wonder which country's episode I should watch today~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B.'s habit of staying up late might continue for a while longer...
